🐶 $DOGE (1W) – MACD Crossover + Fibonacci Confluence

Dogecoin (DOGE) is in a critical phase, with indicators pointing to a possible reactivation of a bullish momentum similar to the one from late 2023.

📊 Key technical observations:

• MACD (1W): New bullish crossover – last https://t.co/LWQkHdyFDE

🐶 $DOGE – Structure under pressure (2-slide update)

📊 Slide 1 (May 25): Weekly MACD bullish crossover + Fibonacci confluence near $0.21 hinted at potential upside – with historical context pointing to a +248% move under similar conditions.

📉 Slide 2 (Now): Price dropped https://t.co/X3q3AeCotP

🚀 $DOGE (1W) — fresh momentum on the meme king

• Weekly candle springs off the 2-year rising trendline, reclaiming the 0.236 Fib (≈ $0.21) with authority
• MACD crosses up from the zero-line for the first time since April — trend power returning
• RSI punches back above 55, https://t.co/Mr0VNzMMSL

$DOGE (1W) – pressure is building 🐶🚀

Price is hugging the multi-month up-trendline and pushing into the 0.382 Fib wall (~$0.30).

If bulls punch through, the weekly Fib ladder opens fast:

 - 0.50 Fib: $0.31

 - 0.618: $0.35

 - 0.786: $0.41

 - 1.0 swing high: $0.48

 - 1.618 https://t.co/mGfehxDNWs

$DOGE weekly — the Shibe is sitting on a 3-point confluence:
• Rising trend-line from 2023 lows
• 20- & 50-week EMAs bunched at $0.21-0.22
• 0.236 Fib of the entire 2024 surge ($0.213)

Momentum mix: MACD barely positive but fading, RSI ~51 (neutral), stoch RSI still lofty at https://t.co/CSPYyHtawi
